ca.name: Beer City Half, Alameda
ca.body: Flat, fast, USATF certified Bay Area waterfront course. Good summer tune-up option. Craft beer at the finish. The 2026 race is done. Registration for the 2027 edition opens December 1, 2026.

ca.name: The San Francisco Marathon
ca.body: Golden Gate Park, across the bridge, through the city. The 2026 race is run, 30,000 finishers across the weekend. Next one is the 50th anniversary edition and registration is already open.

ca.name: Napa to Sonoma Wine Country Half
ca.body: Point-to-point through active vineyards, Cuvaison Estate to Sonoma Plaza, with the Rosé 5K on the plaza the day before. The 2026 race is run. The 2027 waitlist is open now and gets you early access pricing plus registration 48 hours before everyone else.

ca.name: Santa Rosa Marathon
ca.body: Wine country roads, mostly flat, multi-distance weekend. The marathon, half and 10K have all sold out. The Saturday 5K is the only distance still open.

ca.name: Californian Dreamin' Half Marathon
ca.body: Flat out-and-back loops on the Long Beach beach path, starting and finishing on Ocean Blvd. Three distances, USATF certified, and the 5K and 10K both come in under $60.

ca.name: Beer City Half, Bishop Ranch
ca.body: East Bay edition. Multi-distance format with a 1-mile option. USATF certified. Good fall training block tune-up.

ca.name: 2XU Long Beach Marathon
ca.body: One of SoCal's most consistent fall race weekends, city streets and coastline, and October in Long Beach is about as good as race conditions get here. The 2026 race is sold out at every distance now, including the 5K, so the only way in is the 2027 waitlist.

ca.name: Two Cities Marathon
ca.body: Central Valley fall classic. Multi-distance, USATF certified, point-to-point. Smaller field, less hype, faster moves through registration.

ca.name: Santa Barbara Half Marathon & 5K
ca.body: Presented by HOKA. 13.1 along the waterfront plus a 5K and a kids fun run, finishing in the Funk Zone.

ca.name: Monterey Bay Half Marathon
ca.body: Sold out in eight days, and the Race Benefactor entries went in fifteen minutes. One of the most beautiful half courses in California. The official waitlist is the only way in now.

ca.name: Berkeley Half Marathon
ca.body: USATF certified East Bay course winding through Berkeley campus, downtown, and the marina. Mid-November race day with full fall conditions.

ca.name: California International Marathon
ca.body: Net downhill, point-to-point, USATF and World Athletics certified. One of the fastest marathon courses in the US. All standard tiers sold out at record speed. Gold Entry Draw closed in May.
ca.statusLabel: Sold Out, Access Code Entry Only

ca.name: San Diego Holiday Half Marathon & 5K
ca.body: 13.1 with a 711-foot net elevation drop along a rolling downhill bike path. A fast December half and a way to end the year with a PR attempt.

ca.name: Carlsbad Marathon, Half & 5K
ca.body: Coastal SoCal race down Carlsbad Boulevard with Pacific views for most of the course. Registration open early for the lowest pricing of the year.

ca.name: Surf City Marathon & Half
ca.body: Pacific Coast Highway through Huntington Beach on Super Bowl Sunday. Coastal, fast, surfboard finisher medal. Annual; 2027 dates expected to be announced.

ca.name: Los Angeles Marathon
ca.body: Stadium to the Sea, Dodger Stadium to Santa Monica. One of the most iconic point-to-point marathon courses in the country. Open entry, no qualifier.

ca.name: Mountains 2 Beach Marathon & Half
ca.body: Net downhill from Ojai to the Ventura coast. Known as one of the fastest BQ marathon courses in California. Annual; 2027 registration opens fall 2026.

ca.name: Hoag OC Marathon Running Festival
ca.body: Annual SoCal weekend with marathon, half, 5K, and combo challenges. Course finishes at OC Fair & Event Center. Open entry, multi-distance.

ca.name: Rock 'n' Roll San Diego
ca.body: Balboa Park start, finish in Little Italy, live music every mile. Annual SoCal classic. 2027 registration opens late 2026.

us.name: Tunnel Light Marathon
us.body: Net downhill point-to-point through the old Iron Horse rail tunnel and along the Snoqualmie Valley Trail. Boston qualifier, and the alternate course is listed as USATF certified. Cult favorite for PR attempts. Storm damage closed sections of the usual course, so 2026 runs an alternate permitted route. Registration closes September 6.

us.name: Life Time Chicago Half Marathon & 5K
us.body: Big-city feel without the lottery. The half marathon sold out, so the ways in now are the waitlist or one of the charity partners. The 5K and kids run are still open.
us.statusLabel: Half Sold Out, Waitlist and 5K Open

us.name: Twin Cities Marathon
us.body: Consistently called the Most Beautiful Urban Marathon. Lakes, parks, fall foliage, city streets. Open entry, no lottery, no qualifier. Register and go.

us.name: Hartford Marathon & Half Marathon
us.body: Flat, fast, USATF certified. A popular Boston qualifier attempt course because the consistency is that good. Open registration, rarely sells out early.

us.name: Steamtown Marathon
us.body: Point-to-point, significant net downhill, USATF certified. Runners who are serious about a PR target Steamtown specifically for the course profile. Small field. Open entry.

us.name: Baltimore Running Festival
us.body: 26th annual event with a scenic harbor course. USATF certified, open entry, multi-distance. Bring a crew at different fitness levels.

us.name: Rocket Mortgage Detroit Free Press
us.body: International Half crosses the Ambassador Bridge into Windsor and back through the tunnel. Marathon and Motor City Half are sold out. International Half still open through Sep 8.
us.statusLabel: Marathon and Halfs Sold Out, 5K Open

us.name: Marine Corps Marathon
us.body: No prize money. No elite wave. Just runners. The course goes past the Lincoln Memorial and through D.C. landmarks. General registration sold out. Charity spots open through July 31.

us.name: CNO Financial Indianapolis Monumental
us.body: Flat, fast, USATF certified. Open registration, no lottery, no qualifier. One of the most runner-friendly big-city race setups in the country.
us.statusLabel: General Sold Out, Charity Entries Open

us.name: Savannah Southern Half Marathon & 5K
us.body: 13.1 through Savannah's historic squares, oak-lined streets, and a finish through Savannah Bananas' Grayson Stadium. Promo code available for $10 off.

us.name: Allianz Richmond Marathon
us.body: Called America's Friendliest Marathon. USATF sanctioned, certified, and a top Boston qualifier course. Full marathon sold out at the fastest pace in event history. Half marathon and 8K still open, waitlist for the full.

us.name: Philadelphia Marathon Weekend
us.body: Full marathon sold out. Half marathon and 8K still open. Certified course through historic Philly. No qualifier for remaining distances.
us.statusLabel: Marathon and Half Sold Out, 8K Open

us.name: Williams Route 66 Marathon
us.body: Full weekend on the Mother Road's 100th birthday: marathon, half, relay, and 5K through downtown Tulsa. Certified course, open entry, and a finish-line party that earns its reputation.

us.name: Space Coast Marathon & Half
us.body: Florida's oldest marathon, 55 years running. Space-themed race day along the Indian River from historic Cocoa Village with a riverfront finish. Full marathon sold out early, the earliest in event history. Half marathon still open but selling fast.

us.name: BMW Dallas Marathon Festival
us.body: 55th year. New dynamic pricing model so the earlier you register the less you pay. Multi-distance fall race weekend in downtown Dallas.

us.name: JAL Honolulu Marathon
us.body: No qualifier, no cutoff time, ages 7 and up. The course runs from Ala Moana through Waikiki, around Diamond Head, and back. Bucket-list December marathon.

us.name: Chevron Houston Marathon Weekend
us.body: Aramco Houston Half on Sunday Jan 17. Flat, fast, USATF certified. Registration runs Nov 1, 2026 through early January.
us.statusLabel: Marathon and Half Sold Out, 5K Open

us.name: Cherry Blossom Ten Mile
us.body: Tidal Basin, cherry trees in peak bloom, ten flat miles. Annual lottery for general entry; charity bibs available. USATF certified.

us.name: Crescent City Classic 10K
us.body: One of the oldest 10Ks in the country and it runs Easter weekend, through downtown New Orleans, the French Quarter and Esplanade Ave. USATF certified. 2027 registration is open, and the entry price steps up in tiers as the date gets closer.

us.name: NYCRUNS Brooklyn Spring Half
us.body: Prospect Park loop course. NYCRUNS runs a clean operation: easy bib pickup, USATF certified, no lottery. The Brooklyn half marathon without the Brooklyn half wait list.
